name: Quicksilver from Capital One

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 15 months on purchases and balance transfers; variable after that. Specific variable APR range not stated on fetched pages.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees when making purchases outside the U.S.

credit_required.notes: Capital One product page and benefits page both state 'Excellent' credit level.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 1.5% cash back on every purchase, every day

categories.label: Hotels, rental cars, vacation rentals and activities booked through Capital One Travel

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back rewards do not expire for the life of the account. No limit on how much you can earn. Can redeem for cash, statement credit, covering a recent purchase, gift cards, or Amazon.com and PayPal purchases.

signup_bonus.description: Earn a $200 cash bonus after spending $500 on purchases within the first 3 months from account opening. Existing or previous cardmembers are not eligible if they have received a new cardmember bonus for this product in the past 48 months.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: You won't pay foreign transaction fees when you make purchases outside the U.S.

benefits.title: Complimentary Concierge Service
benefits.description: Comprehensive, personalized assistance for dining, entertainment and travel needs, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Terms, conditions and exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extend the manufacturer's warranty at no charge on eligible items purchased with a qualifying card.

benefits.title: 24-hour Travel Assistance Services
benefits.description: Receive an emergency replacement card and a cash advance if your card is lost or stolen, subject to credit availability.

benefits.title: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: If you use your Quicksilver card to purchase your fare, you may be eligible for automatic insurance at no extra charge.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: If you buy something with your Quicksilver card and it's damaged or stolen within 90 days of the purchase date, you may be covered up to $1,000 per loss and up to $25,000 per year.

benefits.title: Price Protection
benefits.description: If you buy an eligible item and see it advertised at a lower price within 120 days of purchase, you may be reimbursed for the difference in price.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability
benefits.description: If your card is lost or stolen, you won't be responsible for unauthorized charges.

other: Hertz Five Star status: Skip the rental counter at select locations and enjoy access to a wider selection of available vehicles with a complimentary upgrade

notes: network_tier set to 'platinum' (Quicksilver is a Visa Platinum-class product); some issuances are Visa Signature.
